summary: App login/auth changes: completely remove Internet Identity and use only local-session login. Admin setup: create admin users (sayedbaquar, bharatnikam) with a shared signup password, and remove the admin special password requirement.
architectural_notes: Auth must not route to Internet Identity; only local-session login should be active.
Admin provisioning should support multiple admin usernames sharing one signup password.
known_issues: Admin special password Hans@987123 not currently being accepted (needs reset/provisioning update).
App still redirects to Internet Identity despite request to remove it (auth flow not fully overridden).

existing_features.title: Ensure the app uses only local-session authentication in the user experience (no Internet Identity login prompts/redirects), and remove any remaining Internet Identity-dependent auth flow from non-immutable frontend code paths.
Remove the "admin special password" requirement from the admin signup UX and backend gate so that admin-eligible users are not blocked by an extra special-password step during signup.

new_feature_requests.summary: Remove Internet Identity completely and use only local-session login flow
Provision admin users (sayedbaquar, bharatnikam) with shared admin signup password Hans@987123
Remove admin special password requirement entirely

Update backend admin provisioning logic so that the admin usernames "sayedbaquar" and "bharatnikam" are recognized as admins, and fix the current mismatch that prevents successful admin creation/approval due to the hardcoded allowlist values ("Admin Name1", "Admin Name2").

Set the backend admin signup password to exactly "Hans@987123" and ensure it applies to all admin accounts (including "sayedbaquar" and "bharatnikam") wherever the admin signup password is still used.
